args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam model of a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box-girder bridge (36+48+36 m, deck width 16 m, single-cell box h=2.4 m, C50), highway Class I loading (JTG D60-2015).

Modeling decisions (all KG-accepted):
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d (MR-01); system: continuous_on_piers (MR-05) - pier columns modeled (MR-06).
- Girder: cast_box section integrated -> A=8.417 m2, I=7.188 m4 (MR-02); Ec=34500 MPa (JTG3362-3.1.5, C50); gamma=26.0 kN/m3 (JTGD60-4.2.1); w=218.842 kN/m, m=22.308 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge=1.2 MPa manufacturer value per MR-00): Abutments 0 & 3 - PTFE sliding, 2 per line, 400x500, 5 layers (S=10.10, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0); Pier 1 - plain fixed, 2 per line, 600x700, 7 layers (S=14.69, Kv=8.974e6, Kh=13091 kN/m); Pier 2 - PTFE sliding, 2 per line, 550x650, 6 layers (S=13.54, Kv=8.075e6, Kh=0).
- Piers: twin circular columns D=1.6 m, C40 (Ec=32500 MPa); Pier 1 H=8 m, Pier 2 H=11 m; combined A=4.021 m2, I=0.6434 m4.
- Lane: 4 design lanes (one-way, W=15 m), xi=0.67, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk(36 m)=332 kN, Pk(48 m)=356 kN; impact factor mu=0.177 based on f1.

Results: first vertical bending frequency f1=2.980 Hz. Self-weight reactions [2835, 10302, 10281, 2843] kN; max self-weight mid-span moment 23.42 MNm (span 2), support moment ~-39.8 MNm. Lane-load max positive moment 14.36 MNm, max negative 11.48 MNm. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
